questions.q: If you double the distance between two planets, what happens to the gravitational force between them?
questions.explanation: Newton's law is an inverse-square law ($1/r^2$). Doubling the distance ($2^2 = 4$) reduces the force to one-quarter.

questions.q: What was Newton's major conceptual breakthrough regarding gravity?
options: That gravity travels at the speed of light
That celestial and earthly gravity are the same force
That gravity is caused by curved spacetime
questions.explanation: Newton unified the heavens and the earth, realizing the force pulling an apple is the same force pulling the moon.
